build.reference_inputs: Between PR #2042 build and this base only Tianxuan/dispatcher host service, tests, documents and receipts changed. Three S07 GDScript inputs are consumed by editor/SCsub and linked via AIWorkbenchSidebar.cpp. Packaged tianshu UI/board and WebView2 inputs are unchanged.
build.command: py -m SCons platform=windows target=editor arch=x86_64 dev_build=no precision=single module_mono_enabled=no ninja=no extra_suffix= tests=yes accesskit=no d3d12=no angle=no cache_path=<shared-readonly-cache> cache_limit=0 --cache-readonly -j6
observed: Using Visual Studio 14.5 with Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0.

receiver.application: Native Godot AI Workbench (headless Windows, isolated copy_editor installation), authenticated Tianxuan HTTP and a local worker process, independently reopened SQLite handle
entries: Sidebar: choose business module, choose issue, open run progress
Issue detail: look up number, open run progress, refresh after process exit
Expanded workbench: reopen the selected module task after process exit
receiver.previous_editor_observation: Native regression reported 'Run progress control missing' on accepted PR #2042 before S07.

corrective_retest.observation: Module running receipt: 无法核对该次运行的最新回执
corrective_retest.cause: The native status API rejects project query parameters with 422, and full status POST rejects viewers with 403. The editor now scopes status by the exact run key already read from the project and consumes the authorized detail projection for viewers.
